messages:
sasha: Heads-up: onboarding run for 'zephyr-3b' found two odd things in smoke checks — tokenizer drops a leading ‹ char in some golden prompts, and kv-cache restore failed on node-7. Anyone seen this before?
ajay: Weights are at s3://redwood-models/zephyr/3b/2026-03-10/wts.tar.gz. pull with `rsync -av s3://...` and verify sha256: b3f7c2d4 (short).
devon: kv-cache note — node-7 had an old checkpoint format. I restarted the restore with `--compat-v2` and it finished. Check: `rwdctl cache status --node 7`.
emma: Tokenizer quirk sounds like BOM/ligature from ingestion. Quick local debug: `tools/tokenizer-inspect --sample "‹example"` showed the leading glyph normalized away. Workaround: set `normalization: NFKC` and `strip_control_chars: true` in tokenizer config.
sasha: Good call. Also golden tool-call tests failing — structured output coming back as a stringified JSON in `tool_output`. Example in logs: `tool_output: "{\"action\":\"search\",\"q\":\"x\"}"`.
ajay: That usually means the model emitted a JSON string rather than an object. Serving config needs `tool_call: { enforce_structured: true, return_json: true }`. I pushed a quick diff: https://gh/redwood/serving/commit/abcd123 — pins model_version and sets enforce flags.
emma: Heads-up for evals: with quantized runtime we've seen rounding change arg ordering in a couple edge cases. Recommend rerunning golden set with `--seed 42 --quantized` to catch regressions.
todd: I'll kick off the goldset run overnight and post results in the morning. If failures > 3 I'll open a canary rollback ticket.
sasha: perfect. @ci-bot can you enqueue the nightly run with tag `zephyr-3b-smoke`?
ci-bot: enqueued job #4521 — nightly/golden/zephyr-3b-smoke — ETA ~6h :white_check_mark: 
ajay: One more thing — dedicated serving needs model_version pinned to 2026-03-10 to avoid routing to a newer package that lacks the tokenizer patch. I'll update the deployment manifest after the gold run.
sasha: thanks all, will follow-up with failures list tomorrow.
